description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'EntityDenormalizerBase' for converting Drupal entity objects into JSON:API array structures, including methods for denormalization and input preparation, and managing dependencies like entity type and field managers.

classes.name: EntityDenormalizerBase
classes.description: An abstract class for denormalizing Drupal entities into JSON:API array structures, managing dependencies and providing a framework for input preparation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing entity type manager, field manager, and plugin manager dependencies.

methods.name: supportsNormalization
methods.description: Indicates whether normalization is supported; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Method intended for normalization; throws exception if called, as normalization is not supported.

methods.name: denormalize
methods.description: Converts data into a Drupal entity object, using resource type info from context and preparing input data.

methods.name: prepareInput
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to prepare input data for entity creation.
